a.xlink:title: Client 1 -- * OrderFromClientAn OrderFromClient has A Client. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Client.A Client has some OrderFromClients. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When an OrderFromClient is created, its Client must be assigned. When an OrderFromClient is deleted, its Client is not deleted and its list of OrderFromClients is decreased. When a Client is deleted, its OrderFromClients are not deleted. They are assigned to another Client.
